en.headline: Tourism Board launches first Halloween Month with citywide cosplay parties
en.dek: Street celebrations begin on Saturday in Central, Lan Kwai Fong, Mong Kok, Tsim Sha Tsui East and Kai Tak, with free admission at several venues.
body: The Hong Kong Tourism Board has begun its first citywide Halloween Month, with themed cosplay parties and installations running from 17 October through the end of the month.

Activities are concentrated on three Saturdays. In Central, Statue Square Gardens (South) hosts immersive installations including large-scale displays, lit from 4pm daily, while Chater Road stages event days. Lan Kwai Fong holds monster-themed gatherings, Mong Kok sees a street festival outside Langham Place, Tsim Sha Tsui East runs music-focused events at Mody Road Garden, and Kai Tak Sports Park features a flash mob and later market activities.

Several of the street parties offer free admission. The Board has also arranged special transport options for visitors in costume on selected days. Organisers said the programme aims to spread celebrations beyond a single night and across different districts.

zh.headline: 旅發局首辦「香港萬聖月」全城Cosplay街頭派對今日啟動
zh.dek: 中環、蘭桂坊、旺角、尖東及啟德多區周六起舉行街頭慶祝活動，多個場地免費入場。
body: 香港旅遊發展局今日起展開首個「香港萬聖月」，全城Cosplay慶祝活動由10月17日持續至月底。
活動集中在三個星期六。中環皇后像廣場花園南面設有大型裝置，每日下午四時起亮燈；遮打道亦有活動日。蘭桂坊舉行怪物主題聚會，旺角朗豪坊外有街頭派對，尖東麼地道花園有音樂活動，啟德體育園則設有快閃及後續市集。
多個街頭派對免費入場。旅發局亦安排了指定日子的特別交通安排供穿著服裝的訪客使用。主辦單位表示，計劃希望將慶祝活動由單一日子擴展至全月，並覆蓋多個地區。
